name: Fast NeRF Composition Pipeline
definition: A three-step rendering framework: 1) NeDF Generation (depth and object ID buffers), 2) Deferred Shading (raw color buffer), 3) Shadow Step (shadow buffer).
summary: The Fast NeRF Composition Pipeline replaces ray marching with Neural Depth Fields to enable interactive previewing of composed NeRF scenes via deferred shading.
